object_context: For a smooth projective complex variety X, codimension p, and alpha in H^{2p}(X,Q) of type (p,p), identify a non-tautological source-producing decomposition or correspondence mechanism that yields an actual Chow preimage of alpha from independently verifiable geometry; reject target-label strengthenings, motivated-category substitutions, and hypotheses equivalent to the unsolved cycle-map surjectivity they are meant to prove.
structural_coordinates: the root is an image/lifting problem from CH^p(X)_Q to rational Hodge classes
a useful bridge must carry source-side algebraic-cycle data, not only enrich the target Hodge class
decomposition is useful only when critical pieces can be discharged by known source cycles or by proving their Hodge target is zero
an assembly theorem must reconstruct the original class from the discharged pieces
a correspondence route is source-producing only when the relevant correspondence/kernel is algebraic at the required authority
a propagation theorem that starts from an algebraic witness cannot solve the initial source-existence gap
coefficient field remains Q and all smooth/projective/complex hypotheses must remain explicit
equivalent_formulations: construct Z in CH^p(X)_Q with cl_Q(Z)=alpha through a source-bearing filtration/correspondence decomposition
cover Hdg^p(X) by images of verified algebraic source maps and prove an exact assembly/surjectivity statement
reduce the root image problem to graded or source-family cycle maps whose remaining Hodge targets are either known-surjective or provably zero
solved_analogues: Lefschetz (1,1): the exponential exact sequence produces a line-bundle/divisor source for codimension-one Hodge classes

Arapura 2021: for a fibration, surjectivity of the graded Leray cycle maps on a specified region implies the Hodge conjecture for the smooth locus; in the fourfold corollary, the only higher-codimension critical piece can also disappear when its Hodge target vanishes
near_solved_analogues: Arapura 2005: moduli spaces can be motivated by curves or surfaces through correspondences built from universal sheaves, allowing Hodge-conjecture checks in special examples
André motivated motives: strong realization control in an enlarged correspondence category, with a separate motivated-to-Chow algebraization boundary
H4d1 deformation lane: witness propagation can be analyzed through Hodge-locus, obstruction, algebraization and globalization arrows once an initial algebraic witness exists

method_transfers.method: filter the Chow group and cohomology by Leray degree, prove surjectivity of source-bearing graded cycle maps on a sufficient region, and assemble the pieces using Hodge-theoretic exactness and Lefschetz symmetries
shared_structure: the target Hodge space is decomposed into pieces with explicit Chow-source maps
global cycle surjectivity is recovered from verified local/graded surjectivity plus an assembly theorem
required_assumptions: a surjective morphism of smooth projective varieties with the smooth-locus setup used in the theorem
the relevant graded cycle maps are surjective on the specified region or their Hodge targets vanish
the exact localization/Leray/Lefschetz hypotheses of the cited theorem
disanalogies: an arbitrary X may not come with a fibration whose critical graded pieces are simpler than the original Hodge problem
surjectivity of an unsolved graded cycle map can merely move the root obstruction rather than solve it
method_transfers.repair_question: Can one choose or construct a source-bearing filtration/fibration for the active X,alpha whose only nontrivial graded Hodge pieces are either already source-realized or vanish for independently provable reasons?
source_anchors: Donu Arapura, Hodge cycles and the Leray filtration, arXiv:2103.05038, Theorem 1.2 and Corollary 1.4

method_transfers.method: construct a correspondence dominating the target, in moduli examples from a universal sheaf and sometimes a Fourier-Mukai-type transform, then transfer Hodge information from source varieties
shared_structure: a geometric source object/correspondence is constructed before target realization is claimed
known source geometry can generate target cohomology through an explicit algebraic interface
required_assumptions: the dominating correspondence/kernel exists as an algebraic geometric object at the required scope
the source varieties/powers satisfy the Hodge inputs needed by the transfer theorem
disanalogies: there is no general universal-sheaf or dominating-correspondence constructor for arbitrary smooth projective X and arbitrary alpha
method_transfers.repair_question: Which intrinsic geometric feature of X or alpha can force an explicit algebraic dominating correspondence from a source family with already-controlled Hodge classes?
source_anchors: Donu Arapura, Motivation for Hodge cycles, arXiv:math/0501348

method_transfers.method: once a Chow witness exists on one fiber, separate Hodge-locus compatibility, formal witness lifting, algebraization, and globalization
shared_structure: both routes require the source witness to survive an exact sequence of bridges before reaching the target class
required_assumptions: an initial algebraic cycle witness is already given
disanalogies: HM1a asks for initial source existence for arbitrary alpha, which H4d1 explicitly assumes rather than produces
method_transfers.repair_question: Can a source-producing HM1a mechanism feed a witness into H4d1 without importing initial algebraicity as an assumption?
source_anchors: RAKL Hodge deformation PR #98, H4d1 expert-context packet; internal cross-fiber evidence only

explicit_disanalogies: a filtered or motivic reformulation is not progress if one of its assumptions is the same unsolved cycle-map surjectivity in new notation
vanishing of a target Hodge piece can eliminate an obligation, but nonvanishing does not construct a source cycle
an André-motivated correspondence is not automatically a Chow correspondence
a universal kernel in a special moduli problem does not imply a constructor for arbitrary varieties
deformation of a known cycle cannot create an initial cycle for an arbitrary Hodge class
integral or generalized Hodge statements are outside the rational root scope unless used only as bounded contrastive evidence
source_anchors: Pierre Deligne, The Hodge conjecture, in The Millennium Prize Problems, Clay Mathematics Institute, 2006
Donu Arapura, Motivation for Hodge cycles, arXiv:math/0501348, revised 2005
Donu Arapura, Hodge cycles and the Leray filtration, arXiv:2103.05038, 2021
A. Grothendieck, Hodge's general conjecture is false for trivial reasons, Topology 8 (1969), 299-303
RAKL issue #86 and H4d1 deformation packet, internal scope-control sources

cross_domain_analogies.source_situation: A complex assembly can be certified from subsystems only when every subsystem carries an admissible source certificate and an interface theorem proves that the certified pieces reassemble to the original object; relabeling an uncertified subsystem does not help.
common_abstraction: global source-existence is decomposed into source-bearing local obligations
some local obligations can be discharged by impossibility/zero-state proofs
an exact assembly map must preserve the root quantity
source_to_target_mapping: empty subsystem state -> vanishing Hodge target
final assembly -> Chow cycle realizing alpha
shared_constraints: every retained target component must have a genuine source certificate or be proved absent
assembly must recover the exact root object rather than a proxy
disanalogies: algebraic cycles and Hodge structures have functorial and cohomological constraints absent from ordinary engineering assemblies
cross_domain_analogies.proposed_principle: Prefer source-bearing decompositions that turn unsolved global surjectivity into a finite collection of independently checkable source-surjectivity or Hodge-vanishing obligations.
cross_domain_analogies.validation_obligation: For any retained mathematical decomposition, specify the source group, target Hodge piece, cycle/realization map, exact assembly theorem, and prove that no remaining obligation is merely the original Hodge surjectivity restated.
cross_domain_analogies.provenance_note: Proposal-organizing analogy only; creates no mathematical authority.

analogy_scan_notes: Scanned source reconstruction, verified assembly, filtration/localization, universal-kernel correspondences, deformation propagation, coniveau/support reframings and target-label strengthenings. Retained only the source-bearing decomposition/assembly abstraction.
